RustDesk 1.0.3 brings the Web Client button in the console back to life.

## 🎨 Design

- **README in the house typeface.** Section headings, the banner and the screenshots now use the same typeface as the other apps, and the download buttons are grouped by device.

## ⚡ Improved

- **Fresh building blocks.** just-containers/s6-overlay 3.2.3.2.
- **Web client over HTTPS explained.** The README says which ports the web client needs and what a reverse proxy has to do when the console is opened over HTTPS.

## 🐛 Fixed

- **The Web Client button opens the web client.** In the console it pointed to `/webclient2/`, which the API image no longer ships, and ended in a 404. It now opens the web client at `/webclient/`.
